answer.rationale: Run a guarded SMB-focused onboarding simplification test to improve time-to-value and activation without sacrificing retention. This uses the confirmed durable benefit from shortened onboarding and the SMB-specific activation lift from signup simplification. Avoid broad promotional pricing: although it can improve acquisition and revenue among price-sensitive SMBs, it materially reduced 30-day retention and risks undermining sustainable qualified revenue. Monitor churn, qualified revenue, activation, and retention before expanding.
